lines: אַךְ הוּא לֹא יִבְגֹּד לְעוֹלָם, אֱהָבֻהוּ!

review: The hymn is the friend above all friends: 1:1–5 is Prov 18:24 with Ps 41:10 and 2 Tim 4:16, and 2:1–5 is Eph 2:14 with Rom 8:37 and Rom 8:28.
The acclamation אֱהָבֻהוּ closes every line that ends a thought, exactly as the print repeats أَحْبِبْ بِهِ; the payload keeps one form of it throughout rather than alternating imperatives.
1:1 uses עָלָה עַל־כֹּל, the verb of Ps 97:9 (עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִים), so the line says the friend is exalted above every other and not merely better liked.
